data.narrative:
Ukrspecsystems is a growth-stage defense and security company founded by Kostyuk Vyacheslav Nikolaevich, currently capitalized through MoD contracts. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 private and public peers in the Defense & Security sector, including public benchmarks DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS, and privately-held peers Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Peer-median valuation methodology was not applicable in this instance. The analysis identified 26 same-sector peers but zero companies meeting the tighter filters of matching stage, adjacent stage, or comparable valuation tier simultaneously. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable bias given Ukrspecsystems' specialized defense contracting profile and capital structure. The narrow peer set constraints—requiring a minimum of three comparable datapoints—could not be satisfied without diluting analytical rigor.

The absence of a triangulated valuation range reflects material data constraints rather than analytical breakdown. Proceeding with valuation would require either expanding the comp set through adjacent-sector defense-tech businesses or conducting bottom-up cash-flow modeling anchored to MoD contract visibility and runway. Key uncertainties include contract renewal rates, funding trajectory, and whether comparable private defense firms with similar revenue scale and government-customer concentration trade at sufficient liquidity to establish reliable multiples. Further diligence on revenue scale, profitability, and capital needs is prerequisite to establishing a defensible valuation.
